title: UI Feedback
symptom: The UI requires long-presses and small touch targets for frequent actions such as setting temp targets, profile switches, and disconnecting the pump, which is difficult for people with shaky hands or when half asleep. The top-right 3-dot menu is described as tiny and too close to the notification bar, causing accidental pulls of the notification shade.
fix: A contributor stated that most proposals discussed in the thread were included in the dev branch, and mentioned work in PR nightscout/AndroidAPS#76; no specific configuration steps or values were provided.
evidence_quote: I think most of proposals discussed here are now included in dev branch.
